info.title: LLM Notary local administration API
info.description: Loopback administration API. Routes are available without credentials by default; configure admin.auth to require HTTP Basic authentication.

get.description: Returns the local service health and API version without requiring authentication.
Returns the exact OpenAPI 3.1 contract implemented by this local service.

get.summary: Get the LLM Notary account connection
get.description: Reports whether this local service has an account connection used for hosted admission, credits, and sharing.

post.description: Starts browser approval for an account connection used for hosted admission, credits, and sharing. Browser approval is unavailable while the daemon uses an injected API key.

delete.description: Removes the local account credentials. Future hosted sessions use public access until a new browser approval is completed. Injected API keys must instead be revoked in the hosted dashboard.

204.description: Account disconnected; hosted sessions return to public access

get.description: Checks a pending LLM Notary account approval after its required polling interval.

Lists the local capture catalog with opaque cursor pagination, punctuation-safe preview search, and exact metadata filters. The legacy offset parameter is rejected; restart traversal without a cursor instead.
Returns safe capture metadata, retained artifact digests, and finalization history for one capture.

post.description: Queues durable proof generation for an eligible captured provider response or returns its existing finalization operation. Captures with non-success provider HTTP responses are rejected before proof generation because the current normalizers only support successful response schemas.

get.description: Returns the exact stored canonical .llmtrace bytes as the primary portable verification artifact.

post.description: Verifies one finalized capture locally, applies the public disclosure safety policy, and uploads the exact package. Force overrides only unexplained high-entropy values.

get.description: Returns the finalized package manifest and canonical OpenTelemetry trace for inspection.

post.description: Verifies the package evidence, disclosure, hashes, provider mapping, and canonical trace against the configured trust source.

get.description: Lists redacted event history with opaque back-pagination and a separate high-water cursor for following new events.

Returns a safe read-only projection of the pinned notary trust history or the explicitly configured self-hosted endpoint and key. Directory membership describes allowed protocol use and does not report endpoint health.
Lists bounded operation summaries, including milestone progress, with opaque cursor pagination and optional state, kind, and capture filters. Fetch one operation for its complete attempt history.
Returns the current state, milestone progress, and complete attempt history for one durable operation.

post.description: Requeues a failed or restart-interrupted operation while preserving its durable identity and attempt history.
Exchanges configured HTTP Basic credentials for an HttpOnly browser session cookie. Returns without a cookie when admin authentication is disabled.

delete.description: Deletes the current browser session and expires its local cookie.

get.description: Returns the latest admission state and stable links for a share.
Returns listener addresses, vault and notary configuration, preview limits, and current capture counts.

force.description: Accept only unexplained high-entropy false positives after review.

high_water_cursor.description: Snapshot cursor for polling events committed after this response.

active_key_id.description:
Selected active directory key. Explicit configuration has no directory
lifecycle selection and therefore leaves this field unset.

directory_source.description: Public URL from which the current pinned directory generation came.

source.description:
`directory` for the locally pinned trust store or
`explicit_configuration` for a self-hosted endpoint and key.

phase.description:
Current milestone: queued, preparing, proving, signing, packaging,
complete, or unknown for an operation migrated from an older catalog.

oneOf.description: Concrete work counters while the private proof is being generated.

PageQuery.description: Query fields shared by every paginated list route.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the same route and filter set.

limit.description: Number of items to return. Each route documents its own maximum.

Page_CaptureResponse.description: Uniform response shape for every paginated list route.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or `null` when this page exhausts the query.

Page_OperationSummaryResponse.description: Uniform response shape for every paginated list route.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or `null` when this page exhausts the query.
